page_2_audit_rationale: PNG fixture is page 1 only (sips can't natively multi-page rasterize on macOS without poppler-utils). At v7.11.0 paste-test, the merchant flagged the missing footer; re-reading the .source.pdf revealed page 2 with Related Products + Footer. Both sections were added to golden.html post-page-1-capture via the PDF audit. This established the v7.11 'Mode B multi-page detection' workflow rule (rubric C-22): when source materials sit alongside the screenshot (.source.pdf, .psd, .ai), the skill MUST scan them for additional sections OR ask the merchant about extra pages. PNG-only inputs with no sibling source files should prompt the merchant for the full page set.

tier_c_expectations.color_snap_misses_required_for: every literal-hex color emitted — palette is intentionally off-slug, so expect at least 4 entries (cream / forest green / walnut / soft black)

notes: Byte-perfect compare against any Mode A golden is NOT expected — Mode B emits literal hex where Mode A emits slug, snapped 4px spacing where Mode A preserves exact JSX margins, and family-only fontFamily slugs where Mode A may carry exact family literals. Structural compare (block names + nesting parity vs the conceptual Mode A baseline) is the acceptance criterion; attribute drift is acceptable when justified by the Tier C drift report. The .source.pdf is included so the rasterization can be reproduced if the PNG is ever lost or needs regeneration at a different resolution.
